principles: Authority belongs to humans. A system's ability to perform an action is capability, never authority.
The public application must not imply that an AI system holds authority merely because it can act.
Every authority decision is auditable: delegation, authorization, and revocation leave records.
Authority boundaries are enforced outside the application, by the KSI governance system and human operators.
